summary: startOpen implements PLAN §1.6.1 (restored place > note jump > TXT remap > DB row, anchor before publishing the session, AnchorSpec only for non-jump opens, pageForOffset vs AnchorMath.pageFor, OWNER_JUMP only when JumpAnchor.matches, returnNav.onJump + peek + intent strip in the showPage message, toast). afterOpen runs §1.6.2's 8 steps with a DEBUG 'RAPerf afterOpen N ms'. Peek via pure PeekRule gates every position write; ended by manual turn, TTS, auto turn, user jumps/return point, 여기서 읽기 (scroll settle via merge note); rp.peek saved/restored. onNewIntent same-book note jump (goTo remember=true, mark, anchor check). Capped cancellable anchor search (JumpAnchor.find/search, 48 sections / 3M chars). NotePlaceHost, bookmark places, chunked backfill (64/post, ≤500). Quotes drawn with style under the K2 rule (sig match or anchor match, lazy per section, cached per session) and exposed to the TOC via new QuotePlaceHost.quoteMoved. DecorDiff.same (incl. style). applyAppSettings/onPause/onDestroy orders. Menu '독서 노트' after '내 리뷰'.
